plainTranslation: Power and control surfacing through the other person. Your autonomy gets tested - someone wants to steer who you are. Failure mode: a battle of wills over identity. Name the game, hold your ground without becoming controlling yourself, and don't confuse the intensity for closeness.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
